verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents native Jira Cloud and Linear integrations that create tasks from tickets and sync/link status back to source issues, directly matching the story for those trackers. However, there is no evidence of ClickUp or Monday.com integrations, so the story is only partially delivered. Missing for 10: ClickUp integration docs, Monday.com integration docs, independent/hands-on verification of ticket sync working in practice.
